meta_description_en: Preview of contents for next month's Outlet: Tasword utilities, UNITRANS+, circuit drawer, games, microdrive helpers, and more.
meta_description_ru: Анонс материалов следующего номера журнала Outlet: утилиты для Tasword, UNITRANS+, адвентюра, утилиты для Microdrive и многое другое.
body_en_plain:
Next month: A Tas 2 word count;
a utility to display blocks of
memory in hex; a utility to con-
vert from Tas 3 to 2; UNITRANS+
a perfected UNITRANS to transfer
automatically any "normal" file
from tape to drive; DRIVECHAT;
OUTCLASS; OUTPUT;a great circuit
drawing program; an adventure;
high speed cassette LOAD/SAVE; a
Roman numeral calc!; a routine
that writes in microdrive syntax
as soon as you touch the key and
a board game against the clock..
body_ru_plain:
В след. месяце: подсчёт слов
Tas 2; утилита для показа блоков
памяти в hex; утилита для кон-
вертации из Tas 3 в 2; UNITRANS+
— улучшенный UNITRANS для авто-
переноса любого "обычного" файла
с ленты на привод; DRIVECHAT;
OUTCLASS; OUTPUT; отличная прог-
рамма черчения схем; адвентюра;
скоростная кассетная LOAD/SAVE;
калькулятор римских чисел!; ру-
тина, пишущая в синтаксисе мик-
родрайва при нажатии клавиши, и
настольная игра на время..
body_en:
## Lookahead

Next month: A Tas 2 word count; a utility to display blocks of memory in hex; a utility to convert from Tas 3 to 2; UNITRANS+ a perfected UNITRANS to transfer automatically any "normal" file from tape to drive; DRIVECHAT; OUTCLASS; OUTPUT; a great circuit drawing program; an adventure; high speed cassette LOAD/SAVE; a Roman numeral calc!; a routine that writes in microdrive syntax as soon as you touch the key and a board game against the clock..
